name: CADCraft
tagline: AutoCAD-style open source CAD in pure Rust — 2D drafting and 3D modeling with DXF support.

body.en: CADCraft is an open-source computer-aided design and drafting application written in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team — a modern, clean-room take on the classic AutoCAD workflow.
body.zh: CADCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队用纯 Rust 编写的开源 CAD 制图应用，对经典 AutoCAD 工作流做了一次干净的现代重写。

body.alt: CADCraft drafting an apartment floor plan in DXF — rooms with areas, a room schedule table, dimensions and a leader note, with the command line at the bottom

body.en: The drafting side covers the essentials: a command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and tables, organized around the DXF and DWG drawings you already have.
body.zh: 制图功能覆盖 CAD 的基本盘：命令行、对象捕捉、图层、标注、填充、图块和表格，围绕已有的 DXF、DWG 图纸展开工作。

body.alt: A mounting bracket mechanical drawing opened from a DWG file — front view and section A-A with dimensions and a title block

body.en: There's a 3D modeling tab for solids, and finished drawings can be arranged on paper layouts for plotting.
body.zh: 除 2D 制图外还有 3D 实体建模标签页，完成的图纸可以排进纸面布局用于出图。

body.alt: The apartment plan arranged on an A1 paper layout ready for plotting

body.en: It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask), and also runs on Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and in the browser via WebAssembly. The project is young — v0.8.0, officially tagged “early development” — so expect rough edges, but the iteration pace is unusually fast.
body.zh: macOS 提供 universal 原生版本（DMG 和 Homebrew cask），也能跑在 Windows、Linux、FreeBSD 上，甚至通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器里运行。项目还很年轻——v0.8.0，官方标注 early development——会有毛边，但迭代速度罕见地快。

description: CADCraft is an open-source computer-aided design and drafting application written in pure Rust by the ArtCraft team. It covers a classic CAD workflow — a command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and DXF drawings — plus a 3D tab for solids. It ships as a native universal macOS app (DMG and Homebrew cask), and also runs on Windows, Linux, FreeBSD and in the browser via WebAssembly. The project is young and officially tagged "early development": v0.8.0 landed in October 2026 and the codebase is moving fast, so expect rough edges — but also unusually quick iteration for a CAD tool.

zh.tagline: 纯 Rust 打造的开源 CAD——类 AutoCAD 工作流，支持 DXF。
zh.description: CADCraft 是 ArtCraft 团队用纯 Rust 编写的开源 CAD 制图应用，对经典 AutoCAD 工作流做了一次干净的现代重写。提供命令行、对象捕捉、图层、标注、填充、图块与 DXF 工作流，另有 3D 实体建模标签页。macOS 提供 universal 原生版本（DMG 和 Homebrew cask），也支持 Windows、Linux、FreeBSD，甚至能通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器里运行。项目还很年轻，官方标注 early development——会有毛边，但迭代速度罕见地快。
